title: Kufey Me Muslim Ko Rone
body:
Kufe Me Muslim (A.S) Ko Rone Aa Gayi Hai Fatema (S.A)
Haaye Gurbat Me Ye Kaisi Be Kasi Hai Fatema (S.A)
<<DIVIDER>>
Daarul Ammara Se Muslim (A.S) Ne Madad Ko Di Sada
PasliyoN Se Hath Hatakar Boli Mere Laal Aa
Hath Failaye Huwe Niche Khadi Hai Fatema (S.A)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hazrate Muslim (A.S) Ke Bachho Ka Pata Milta Na Tha
Kon Apna Tha Waha Jo Jaake Unko Dhundhta
Kufe Ki Galiyooñ Me Unko Dhundhti Hai Fatema (S.A)
<<DIVIDER>>
Zakhmi HonthoN Se Lahoo Muslim (A.S) Ka Paani Me Gira
Wo Badi Hasrat Se Paani Ki Taraf Takta Raha
Dekh Kar Manzar Ye Sar Ko Pit'ti Hai Fatema (S.A)
<<DIVIDER>>
Daarul Ammara Se Muslim (A.S) Ko Giraya Kyu Gaya?
HaddiyaN Tooti Badan Ki Para Para Sar Hua
Kya Khata Iski Hai Logo Puchhati Hai Fatema (S.A)
<<DIVIDER>>
Keh Rahi Hai Roke Zahra Zulm Hai Tujpe Bada
PasliyaaN Tooti Hai Teri Gham Hai Ye Sab Se Bada
Dard Beta Pasliyoñ Ka Jaanti Hai Fatema (S.A)
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Tarah Pardes Me Dekhe Na Koi Ayse Gham
Jis Tarah Kufe Me Muslim (A.S) Par Hue Zulm O Sitam
Khakh Udaye Lash Par Ye Keh Rahi Hai Fatema (S.A)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Asad Haalaat Dekhe Kufe Ke Abbas (A.S) Ne
Muntazir Hu Bole Ghazi (A.S) Izn Do Moula Mujhe
Dekhta Hu Lashe Muslim (A.S) Pe Khadi Hai Fatema (S.A)
author: Asad Abbas Kanodari
